stage: Before any new formulation cohort; one N8 real-THRML API smoke already completed and is disclosed

initialization.fixed_and_adaptive: Independent Bernoulli(0.35) item bits; same declared seed mapping, distinct backend PRNG trajectories
initialization.token_prefix: Bernoulli(0.35) item bits; prefix sums clipped at B, slack max(B-sum,0). This is label-blind and may begin inconsistent when overbudget
initialization.cardinality: Chain index cycles across allowed positive K buckets; random K-subset initialized without labels; exact prefix counts, final count clamped K

epoch_accounting: Carry complete item and auxiliary state between 8 epochs; each epoch has20 updates and10 retained observations. All8 penalty levels together use160 updates and80 observations per chain. No8x budget expansion

sparsity_limits.on_limit_exceeded: Stop and report unsupported resource/formulation boundary; do not replace with dense budget coupling

table_accounting: Report every domain size and actual table entries/bytes; local ternary prefix factors have2*D*D entries each. Bounded graph degree is not a binary hardware cost claim
cost_accounting: Report assembly, lowering, compilation, sample execution, feasibility/decode/rank, final winner verification, and diagnostic first-valid scan separately. Like-for-like decision uses optimizer plus one final verifier; diagnostic scan is excluded from both comparison totals but retained in whole experiment wall time. First execution of each compiled shape is identified separately from later warm executions
structure: Original graph is one6-node connected semantic core plus disjoint noise pairs/singletons. Component knapsack DP is an exact original-objective comparator at every planned size; report component sizes and DP assembly/solve/final verification cost

smoke.purpose: API wiring only; no parameters changed in response
